_cap_minutes: 25 rather than the vault's 12, because these issues are room-building rather than bug-fixing and a lane needs time to build, shoot, LOOK at the pictures, and fix what it sees. Not higher: run_budget_minutes is 45 across all 71 repos, and a lane that eats most of a run starves everyone else.
_max_issues_per_run: One. Each remaining issue is a substantial piece of the room, and a lane that rushes three of them produces three PRs nobody wants to review.
note: Unparked 2026-08-26 once the repo could be SEEN: `npm run shot` renders the demo floor headless and writes PNGs a lane can read. Before that, a lane could only prove a build passed, which proves nothing about a room. CLAUDE.md carries the rule. Every remaining issue splits into a read half (unit-testable) and a draw half (needs the pictures); a lane that fails at drawing should still land the adapter.
